parsed.production_notes: The central visual of a baby skydiving is physically implausible and a common AI-generated video meme format. The baby's expressions and movements, while varied, have a slightly unnatural and repetitive quality typical of current AI video generation.
parsed.interaction_pattern: Narrator explains product benefits and a timeline for learning progress.
parsed.audio_track: A child's voiceover in Tamil speaks over upbeat instrumental music for the majority of the ad, followed by an adult male voiceover in English for the final call-to-action.

characters.appearance: A South Asian infant, approximately 6-12 months old, with a very chubby build, prominent round cheeks, and visible belly rolls. The baby has dark, short hair, large, expressive dark brown eyes, and a brown complexion. There are some small, indistinct marks or blemishes on the baby's upper arms.
characters.wardrobe: The baby wears only a white diaper, a white open-face pilot's helmet with silver-rimmed goggles pushed up onto the forehead, and a grey skydiving harness with straps over the shoulders and around the waist.
characters.demeanor: Extremely cheerful, joyful, and excited. The baby maintains a wide, toothy grin for most of the video, looking directly at the camera with an energetic and happy expression.

scenes.setting: Mid-air, high above the clouds during the day. The sky is blue with fluffy white clouds. Below, a patchwork of green and brown fields is visible.
scenes.camera: Medium close-up, facing the character as they 'fall'.

panels.panel_visual_description: A medium close-up shot of Character A, a chubby South Asian baby, seemingly skydiving. The baby is wearing a white pilot's helmet with goggles pushed up and a grey harness over a white diaper. With arms outstretched, the baby has a joyful, wide-mouthed smile, looking directly at the camera. In the first second, the baby is seen sitting in the open doorway of a small propeller plane before jumping out. The background is a bright blue sky filled with fluffy white clouds, with a view of the ground far below showing a grid of fields. The lighting is bright and sunny.

scenes.visual_description: A continuous shot of an AI-generated baby, Character A, skydiving against a blue sky. Various text overlays in Tamil appear sequentially over the baby, highlighting key phrases from the voiceover. Graphic elements like '15 Days', '2 Weeks', the MySivi logo, and app store ratings also pop up and disappear throughout the scene. The baby's expression changes slightly but remains overwhelmingly happy and excited.
scenes.audio_transcript:
Unknown speaker says: English கத்துக்கணுமா? [Want to learn English?]
Unknown speaker says: அதுவும் கஷ்டப்படாம? [Without any difficulty?]
Unknown speaker says: வெறும் 15 நாள்ல? [In just 15 days?]
Unknown speaker says: அப்போ MySivi-யோட 15 day challenge-அ start பண்ணுங்க. [Then start MySivi's 15-day challenge.]
Unknown speaker says: 2-3 days-ல அந்த flow-வ புடிச்சிடுவீங்க. [In 2-3 days, you'll get the flow.]
Unknown speaker says: One week practice பண்ணீங்கன்னா, ஓரளவுக்கு சமாளிக்கிற confidence வந்துரும். [If you practice for one week, you'll get enough confidence to manage.]
Unknown speaker says: 2 weeks-ல நல்ல தைரியமா பேச ஆரம்பிச்சிடுவீங்க. [In 2 weeks, you'll start speaking with good confidence.]
Unknown speaker says: நம்பலைன்னா Play Store, App Store reviews-லாம் கூட பாருங்க. [If you don't believe it, check the Play Store and App Store reviews.]
Unknown speaker says: Cheap-ஆன வழில fast-ஆ English கத்துக்கணும்னா MySivi தான் தேவை. [If you want to learn English fast in a cheap way, you need MySivi.]
Unknown speaker says: உடனே install பண்ணுங்க. [Install it immediately.]
